verdict.rationale: Elasticsearch documents a one-line local quickstart (docker/curl installer) and official client libraries, and a hands-on probe confirms a real Docker deployment with index+search roundtrip working with BM25 scoring in seconds. Missing for 10: a first-party 'X minutes' quickstart tutorial walkthrough end-to-end and independent third-party reviews specifically praising quickstart speed (community feedback instead focuses on pricing/licensing, not the quickstart itself).
